title: Towel Stand With 4 Pivoting Swing Arms, 49-Inch, Solid Brass, Freestanding | Fire Engine Red | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels organized and within reach without drilling into your walls in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. This freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel stand adds flexible hanging space wherever you need it in the bathroom.

  • Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Stay stable on the floor with a large, weighted base designed to help prevent tipping.
  • Built for daily use from solid brass materials to resist rust and corrosion.
  • Coordinate a cohesive bath as part of the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection with multiple designer finish options.

Specs & Installation

  • Type: Freestanding swing arm towel stand
  • Arms: 4 pivoting swing arms
  • Material: Solid brass
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in. x 49 in. x 9.25 in.
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
  • Assembled in the USA
